item.title: Sarah J. Maas Announces Two New Back-to-Back 'A Court of Thorns and Roses' Books
item.description: Sarah J. Maas has confirmed two new back-to-back instalments in the hugely popular ACOTAR series. item.description: Mumbai: The first of the two flights, arranged by Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Eknath Shinde to ferry tourists from Maharashtra stranded in the UAE due to the US-Israel-Iran conflict, landed in Mumbai on Tuesday night with around 70 passengers on board, Shiv Sena MLAs said.Stay updated with the latest breaking news, traffic alerts, and major developments from India’s top cities - Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru, Chennai, and Kolkata - only on Times Now.

item.title: ‘Tomorrow, It May Start Demanding Lakshadweep’: Experts Slam US After Iranian Frigate Sunk In Indian Ocean
item.description: The sinking of Iranian frigate IRIS Dena by a US submarine in the Indian Ocean has triggered legal and strategic concerns, with experts warning the move could undermine maritime norms and affect India.

item.title: Harassed Over Dowry: Bengaluru Woman Techie Dies By Suicide After Fight With Mother-In-Law
item.description: A techie woman in Bengaluru allegedly died by suicide due to the ongoing domestic disputes with her mother-in-law. Sushma's family has accused her husband and in-laws of dowry harassment, following which the police have taken the husband into custody.

item.title: After Nitish Kumar, Who Will Be Bihar's Next CM? 3 Leaders Who Could Take Charge
item.description: Bihar's Chief Minister, Nitish Kumar, has announced his resignation to pursue a Rajya Sabha position. With his departure, speculation regarding his successor has intensified, with senior BJP leaders like Samrat Choudhary and Nityanand Rai seen as frontrunners.
